name: Manchester
title: Exorcist Knight of the West
description:
At a young age, her talents were recognized by the Western Exorcist Church, and she became a knight devoted to hunting wraiths.
Despite her slender appearance, she possesses the strength to swing a massive blade with ease, and her reliable work has earned her the deep trust of the Church.

localization.name: Crushing Blade
localization.description:
400% damage to 1 enemy. 800% damage instead every second time this skill is activated while on the battlefield. This attack ignores enemy damage reduction effects and any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the target from being defeated.

Removes Poison (including Lethal Poison) from the user, and grants the user a Poison Ward and Sleep Ward. Each Ward prevents their named effect from being applied once, then is removed. Identical Wards cannot stack.

localization.name: Earth's Exorcism
localization.description:
All allies on the battlefield heal for 500% of the user's attack.

All non-burning allies on the battlefield will have the TU costs for all of their skills reduced by 30%, this will overwrite the effects of other Quicken skills. The enemy team lose 1 Spirit for each non-burning enemy on the battlefield.

Then if enemy Spirit is 0, there is a 20% chance, plus 20% per Awakening (up to 100% chance if this unit has 4 Awakenings) for a random non-boss, non-Ephemeral enemy on the battlefield to be immediately defeated (the user is considered to have defeated that enemy with an attack). This effect ignores Revenge passive skills, Revival passive skills, and any passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the random enemy from being defeated.

This skill becomes locked for 50TU after use. Usable 10 times per battle.

localization.name: Mighty Resolve
localization.description:
The user is Fortified, and granted Earthen Might for 100TU.

Usable only if the user has stored 3 Charges, and is not burning. Consumes all Charges on the user. Usable 3 times per battle.

A Fortified unit has 50% damage reduction from attacks. This reduction cannot be ignored by attacks that do not specifically ignore Fortify. Fortify will be removed after reducing damage 3 times since applying, and will be reset if reapplied. This is not a status effect. A unit with Earthen Might has 0.5x of their original Attack added to their Attack while they are not burning. This attack increase does stack on top of Enrage effects, and other Attack increases (e.g. 1.5x + 0.5x => 2.0x total), but cannot stack with Earthen Might effects. Earthen Might ends if the unit who granted it leaves the battlefield, and is removed from units that leave the battlefield.
localization.selected: User is Fortified & Gains Earthen Might

localization.name: Grassroots Defiance
localization.description:
This unit can't have its Active Skills disabled by enemy passive skills.

This unit cannot be stunned or be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield.

Whenever this unit defeats a non-conjured unit on the battlefield with an attack, heals all allies on the battlefield for 100% of their max HP, and ends any enemy effects that are currently disabling the Active Skills of allies on the battlefield.

Whenever another ally on the battlefield damages any number of non-burning units with an attack, this unit is granted Sleep Thorns and has its current TU reduced by 50TU. If this triggers 5 times within 50TU, this effect cannot trigger again until 50TU advances.

This unit's attacks heal this unit for 100% of total damage dealt, will not wake sleeping enemies, and grant hit targets:
- Cursed Sleep for 200TU if this unit has 2 or more Water Allies on the battlefield.
- Lethal Poison for 999TU if this unit has 2 or more Dark Allies on the battlefield.
- Randomly either Cursed Sleep for 200TU or Lethal Poison for 999TU if this unit does not have 2 Water or 2 Dark Allies on the battlefield.

When a unit with Sleep Thorns is dealt damage by an attack, that unit's Sleep Thorns will be consumed to immediately grant the Cursed Sleep status effect for 200TU to the attacker. Burn or attacks that grant Burn will remove Sleep Thorns and prevent Cursed Sleep from applying. Cursed Sleep will overwrite status effects other than Burn, cannot be overwritten by Poison, can be applied repeatedly to units that have already slept while on the battlefield, and will not end from damage caused by Dream Hunter type active skills. Lethal Poison will overwrite other status effects on that enemy, cannot be overwritten by status effects other than Burn or Stealth, and cannot be Purified. Lethal Poison deals 2 times the damage of normal Poison and ignores passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the target from being defeated, other than those which specifically prevent defeat from Poison or non-attack damage. Lethal Poison cannot apply to Burning units or Boss units.

localization.name: Exorcist Knight
localization.description:
This unit enters battle Fortified, and with a Sleep Ward, Poison Ward, and an Instant Death Ward.

If this unit would be defeated by an enemy attack or a status effect while having more than 1 HP, it instead survives with 1 HP.

Each time a non-burning ally gets the turn, this unit is healed for 50% of max HP. Each time a poisoned or sleeping enemy gets the turn, this unit is healed for 50% of max HP.

Each time this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn, this unit will be granted a Charge, and heal for 50% of its max HP. Certain skills are affected by and may consume charges. A unit can store a maximum of 3 charges, and all charges are removed from a unit that leaves the battlefield.

An Instant Death Ward prevents this unit from being immediately defeated without damage by a non-boss enemy once, then is removed. Instant Death Wards cannot be ignored and cannot stack.

localization.name: HP Up Lv3
localization.description: Adds 1200 to this unit's max HP.

localization.name: Sleep Resist Lv3
localization.description: Reduces the duration of any enemy sleep effects on this unit by 20TU.

localization.name: Greataxe Mastery
localization.description: Can use weapon skills of Greataxes in addition to their original preferred weapon type.
